name: Hirata (Japan)
description: A orange field charged at the centre with the Hirata village emblem in white: a ring with two pointed ears at the top.
history: Municipal flag of Hirata, a village in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 22 June 1984; the emblem dates from 16 March 1979.

features.role: Hirata village emblem — a ring with two pointed ears at the top
